
---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6

billboard |>
  filter(
    track %in% c(
      "Breathe",
      "Everything You Want",
      "I Wanna Know",
      "Maria, Maria"
    )
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week = as.numeric(str_remove(week, "wk"))
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = seq(1, 100, 10)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "#FF4FA3",
    "#8B5CF6",
    "#00C9A7",
    "#FFB703"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "The Race to #1",
    subtitle = "Billboard Hot 100 | 2000",
    x = "Weeks on the chart",
    y = "Billboard ranking",
    color = "Song",
    caption = "Source: tidyr billboard dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray40"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
